title: Deception about study purpose does not affect participant behavior.
note: OSF f6gmb is public but has no licence (node_license null, no licence relationship); Data Availability gives a view_only link to it. Article CC BY does not reach the node.

title: Social entrepreneurial intention among university students in China.
note: 9 tables (4-5 items), N=681, 1-5; item text shipped (data_labels via SI Table S1); 3 double submissions dropped.

title: Extending UTAUT with national identity and fairness to understand user adoption of DCEP in China.
note: 6 tables x 3 items, N=295, 1-7; SI csv + questionnaire docx; item text not shipped (positional within construct).

title: Americans weigh an attended emotion more than Koreans in overall mood judgments.
note: OSF 6w42k is public with no licence (checked via API).

title: The mediating role of schadenfreude between malicious envy and bullying in school.
note: OSF 6xrdh is private (API 401; it is only the preregistration). The data are at AUSSDA (doi:10.11587/VKNKYE, 10.11587/LLBHDK) under the AUSSDA Scientific Use Licence, restricted files, no redistribution.

title: Discordance in gender role attitudes between spouses and its relationship with the risk biomarkers of cardiovascular diseases: a couple-level analysis.
note: 1 table, 6 marital-quality items, 616 spouses in 308 couples (cluster_id), 1-3; deposit label strings contradict the paper's coding, codes fixed by exact reconstruction of the deposit's own composites.

title: Barriers to the widespread adoption of diagnostic artificial intelligence for preventing antimicrobial resistance.
note: Dryad CC0 data (downloaded via headless Chrome; API needs a token) holds per person only a World-AI preference % (its complement), one agree/disagree and one which-AI choice, across 9 country files (41,978 respondents): 2-3 non-scale questions, not an item-response instrument.

title: The mediating role of ICT learning confidence and technostress between executive functions and digital skills.
note: OSF zxag5 (public, no licence) holds only computed scores (CFS, tstresstotal, CARS_total, IAStotal, Flanker means etc.), 269 x 21, no item-level responses; would also be licence-blocked.

title: Physician marriage survey reveals sex and specialty differences in marital satisfaction factors.
note: Physician marriage survey xlsx (322 x 89) is a descriptive Qualtrics export: demographics, marital history, one satisfaction question and select-all stress/stability factor checklists; no multi-item scale.

title: An authoritarianism-compatible text changes British attitudes towards EU immigration.
note: OSF hbu5x and its data component vntm5 are public with no licence (checked via API; earlier failure was a transient 502).

title: Social and political trust diverge during a crisis.
note: OSF mxgzr is public with no licence (checked via API); Data Availability gives a view_only link.

title: Best humans still outperform artificial intelligence in a creative divergent thinking task.
note: Data are on OSF qdz3n, private (API 401), reachable only through the view_only link in the Data Availability statement; SI is a docx of extra models only.

title: A survey of clinicians on the use of artificial intelligence in ophthalmology, dermatology, radiology and radiation oncology.
note: SI is a docx of aggregate supplementary tables only; Data Availability says raw data available on request.

title: Development and validation of Egyptian developmental screening chart for children from birth up to 30 months.
note: Lead file s005 (337 kids) holds only grades/totals; the item data are in s004 (served as .zip, actually SPSS .sav): 1503 children x 54 binary milestones. Item text shipped from the deposit's Arabic checklist (s002) with IRW English translation.

title: Let's talk about pain catastrophizing measures: an item content analysis.
note: Crombez 2020 pain-catastrophizing item content analysis: 94 Prolific raters (<100) rating item relevance; also the OSF node 4khyq is public with no licence (node_license null), so it would be a licence block anyway.

title: The ability of the green peach aphid (Myzus persicae) to penetrate mesh crop covers used to protect potato crops against tomato potato psyllid (Bactericera cockerelli).
note: Aphid mesh-penetration trial: insect counts per petri dish over time (GenStat sheets), not item responses.

title: Impact of work environment perceptions and communication satisfaction on the intention to quit: an empirical analysis of nurses in Saudi Arabia.
note: Alsufyani 2021 nurses (PES-NWI 31 + CSQ 25 + intention-to-quit 3, labelled .sav): the 367 rows are only 51 distinct respondents, each copied 5-10 times (identical on every column but Code). Duplicate network; effective N=51 < 100.

title: The discriminative power of the ReproQ: a client experience questionnaire in maternity care.
note: dup_id_item resolved: invitation tokens link the antenatal (s001) and postnatal (s002) files (2,770 women in both, unit/parity/age agree far above chance); same-token exact copies are double submissions (94 dropped); same-token conflicting rows are token collisions (separate women); 1,590 blank tokens unlinked. One table, wave 1/2, phase-specific item codes.

title: A number sense as an emergent property of the manipulating brain.
note: Number-sense paper is a computational model (Kondapaneni & Perona); SI is a single PDF, no human response data (supplementaryFiles fetched OK on retry).

title: Preference for facial averageness: Evidence for a common mechanism in human and macaque infants.
note: Facial-averageness eye-tracking: per-trial looking times for small samples (e.g. 18 adults; infant/macaque groups), continuous fixation data, not item responses.

title: Anger provocation in violent offenders leads to emotion dysregulation.
note: Anger-provocation study: data 'available from the corresponding author on reasonable request'; the only SI is a .doc of supplementary tables. No deposited response data.

title: Long-term stress in dogs is related to the human-dog relationship and personality traits.
note: Dog stress: SI holds hair cortisol plus MDORS/BFI/dog-personality SUM scores per dog (~100 rows) and a 42-row lifestyle sheet; no item-level responses.

title: Sharing and caring: Testosterone, fathering, and generosity among BaYaka foragers of the Congo Basin.
note: BaYaka fathers: 45 men, repeated testosterone samples plus aggregated peer-nomination z-scores; no items, N<100.

title: Influence of age and cognitive demand on motor decision making under uncertainty: a study on goal directed reaching movements.
note: Reaching movements: OSF qsfg4 is CC BY 4.0, but the files are per-participant aggregated kinematics (path length, RT, confidence means by condition, ~1-2 KB each); no item responses.

title: HD-tDCS mitigates the executive vigilance decrement only under high cognitive demands.
note: HD-tDCS ANTI-Vea: data on OSF 876fe (public, node_license null; parent yvc4z also unlicensed). Content is trial-level E-Prime output for 181 participants (single/dual/triple load x sham/anodal); a reaction-time task with randomised trials, so a marginal IRW fit even if licensed.

title: A break in parental interaction does not affect the temporal dependency of infant social engagement, but disrupts non-social engagement.
note: Infant social engagement: continuous engagement time series with lagged predictors (L0-L5, centred terms), 109 infants; dup_id_item flag came from the time series, not items.

title: Consistency and flexibility in solving spatial tasks: different horses show different cognitive styles.
note: Horse spatial tasks: 27 horses x repeated trial times/laterality indices; N<100 and not item responses.
